infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Officer requires real-time access to your precise location to verify ground truth incidents and navigate to hazard sites.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Officer requires background location access to broadcast continuous position to the SDRF GIS Command center.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Officer requires camera access to photograph evidence and upload field reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Officer requires photo library access to attach photos of incidents and terrain conditions.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Officer to access your location to verify ground truth incidents and navigate to hazard sites.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Officer to access your location to broadcast position to SDRF GIS Command.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Officer to select photos of incidents and terrain conditions.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Officer to capture live photos of evidence and ground truth verification.
